papers.headline: Interaction of Strong X-mode Waves with Magnetized Pair Plasmas
papers.summary: The interaction of strong (a₀>1), superluminal X-mode electromagnetic waves with magnetized pair plasma falls into two regimes set by varepsilon_Bequiv a₀ω_B/ω₀, the ratio of the wave strength parameter to its frequency, in units of cyclotron frequency.
papers.title: Interaction of Strong X-mode Waves with Magnetized Pair Plasmas

papers.headline: Spectroscopic Survey of Small Solar System Bodies with Ariel
papers.summary: The small Solar System bodies (SSSBs) preserve records of the formation and evolution of the Solar System.
papers.title: Spectroscopic Survey of Small Solar System Bodies with Ariel

papers.headline: The Impact of Flyby Interactions on the Rotation of Open Clusters
papers.summary: The Gaia astrometric mission has provided the first evidence for the bulk rotation of open clusters.
papers.title: The Impact of Flyby Interactions on the Rotation of Open Clusters
papers.authors: K. R. Tregoning, J. J. Andrews
